title: Fix remaining smt2_test blocks
description:
Scope:
- Fix every test block still in src/smt2_test.mbt (currently 903 blocks).
- Each block must pass run_smt, then be moved to src/smt2_passed_test.mbt.

Per-block workflow:
1) moon test src/smt2_test.mbt --filter "<name>"
2) Fix solver/parsing/runtime until the block passes.
3) Move that test block to src/smt2_passed_test.mbt.
4) moon info && moon fmt
5) git commit -m "<name>" (include .beads/issues.jsonl)

Progress tracking:
- Update this issue notes with last completed block and next block to tackle.
- Completed so far: 2546.

title: Fix smt2 test z3.27
description:
Goal: Make test block "z3.27" in src/smt2_test.mbt pass.

Context:
- Test source: smt2/z3.27.smt2
- Expected output: smt2/z3.27.expected.out
- The solver currently runs each test via run_smt in src/run.mbt and compares output.

Steps:
1) moon test src/smt2_test.mbt --filter "z3.27"
2) Diagnose failure; fix solver or parser.
3) Re-run the test to confirm.
4) Move the test block to src/smt2_passed_test.mbt.
5) moon info && moon fmt
6) Commit with message "z3.27" and include .beads/issues.jsonl.
